lines.text: God appeared to Abraham in Mesopotamia and told him to leave his country for a land He would show him.
The patriarchs sold Joseph into Egypt out of jealousy, but God rescued him and Pharaoh made him ruler over Egypt.
Joseph sent for Jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all, and Jacob went down to Egypt.
After striking down an Egyptian at forty, Moses fled to the land of Moab, where he lived as a foreigner.
The people told Aaron to make gods for them, and God said He would send them into exile beyond Assyria.
